仙侠、脑洞、年代，三次测评共 90 篇作品、306 份双盲评分。: Xianxia, high-concept and period: three benchmarks, 90 works, 306 double-blind ratings.
三期的评分维度、评委分组和加权规则相同，题材考点不同。: The three issues share the same scoring axes, reviewer grouping and weighting — what changes is what each genre tests.
三期均分为 5.80、6.04、6.17，最大相差 0.37 分。整体评分松紧接: The three issues' means are 5.80, 6.04 and 6.17 — at most 0.37 apart. Scoring severity is close enough that comparing across issues is basically sound.
不同题材，分数差在哪: Where the genres pull the scores apart
下面是每期十个模型的维度均分。: Below are the axis means of each issue's ten models.
脑洞题材：网文感天然占便宜: High-concept: web-fiction feel comes built in
网文感均分 6.53，比仙侠（5.88）和年代（5.69）高出大半分。 「微信群: Mean web-fiction feel is 6.53, a good half point above xianxia (5.88) and period (5.69). “Newton pops up in a WeChat group” carries its own payoffs and conflict. Logic is also the lowest of the three at just 5.35 — the wilder the premise, the harder it is to make it hold.
年代题材：逻辑最稳，网文感最难: Period: steadiest logic, hardest web-fiction feel
逻辑均分 5.78 是三期最高，网文感 5.69 是三期最低。 年代文顺着生活逻: Mean logic of 5.78 is the highest of the three issues; web-fiction feel of 5.69 is the lowest. Period fiction follows the logic of everyday life, so hard flaws are rarer. The difficulty is writing ration coupons and communal housing blocks so they ring true — while keeping the story fun to read.
<strong>AI 感这一项的质量分连续三期下滑</strong>，从 4.3: The quality score for AI tells has slid three issues running, from 4.36 to 4.16 to 3.99, finishing last of the five axes every time. Sounding like a machine is still the most widespread problem.
篇幅与得分的相关系数，脑洞题材是 <strong>0.71</strong>，年: The correlation between length and score is 0.71 for high-concept and just 0.14 for period. High-concept stories need room to lay the premise out — cut the words and it stops making sense; period fiction runs on picking the right details, and no word count piles up into period feel.
侧重点不同，榜就重排: Change what's being tested, and the board reshuffles
脑洞篇和年代篇同一天入库，由同一批评委在同一时期评完，适合直接看题材带来的变化。: The high-concept and period issues entered the pool on the same day and were scored by the same reviewers over the same stretch — the cleanest place to watch what genre alone does.
脑洞与年代两个题材的名次变化: How ranks shift between the high-concept and period genres
左边是脑洞名次，右边是年代名次。模型和评委相同。: High-concept ranks on the left, period on the right. Same models, same reviewers.
脑洞第 6（5.92）→ 年代第 10（4.67），掉了 4 名、1.25 分。: 6th on high-concept (5.92) → 10th on period (4.67): down 4 places and 1.25 points. Its web-fiction feel of 7.30 on high-concept (second in the field) shrinks to 5.32 on period, and its AI-tells quality score drops from 4.62 to 2.31.
脑洞第 4（6.28）→ 年代第 1（7.19）。 它在脑洞题材写出过 8.00: 4th on high-concept (6.28) → 1st on period (7.19). On high-concept it wrote an 8.00 and a 4.33, a range of 3.67; on period its three chapters tighten to 8.00 / 7.36 / 6.20. The moment it steadied, it took the top.
十个模型里有八个换题材后名次发生了变化，只有 <strong>DeepSeek: Eight of the ten models change places when the genre changes; only DeepSeek V4 Pro and GPT-5.6 Terra hold perfectly still (7th and 8th both times). The gap between one model's genres can be wider than the gap between models. Choose the genre first, then the model.
三期名次 1 / 1 / 3，总分极差只有 0.66。目前唯一不挑题材的模型。: Ranks 1 / 1 / 3 across the three issues, with a total-score range of just 0.66. Currently the only model that doesn't mind which genre it's handed.
仙侠第 4 是它三期最好的名次（此后第 9、第 6）。架空世界观这道题它答得最顺: 4th in xianxia is its best rank of the three (9th and 6th after that). An invented world is the question it answers most fluently.
脑洞第 6，前后两期分别第 9、第 10。脑洞篇它的网文感冲到 7.30，全场第: 6th on high-concept, against 9th and 10th in the issues either side. In the high-concept issue its web-fiction feel surged to 7.30, second in the field.
年代篇登顶（7.19），年代细节写得又真又稳。三期名次 5 → 4 → 1，一路: Topped the period issue (7.19), with period detail that reads true and stays steady. Ranks of 5 → 4 → 1 across three issues — straight up.
每个模型每期只有三篇，以上只看倾向。详细限制见文末。: Each model gets only three chapters per issue, so read these as leanings. The full caveats are at the end.
章纲也会拉开差距: The beat sheet opens gaps too
三期都让模型拿章纲直接写正文，三份章纲的来源和质量不同。: All three issues had models write prose straight from a beat sheet — and the three beat sheets differ in origin and quality.
来自已发表作品，节奏、冲突和钩子更完整。: From a published work — pacing, conflict and hooks arrive more complete.
章纲的质量，非常影响正文的质量。同样是无提示词直出，好章纲能带来更好的表现； 章: Beat-sheet quality weighs heavily on prose quality. With the same bare, no-prompt generation, a good beat sheet buys visibly better prose; if the beat sheet carries an AI flavour, the prose never quite scrubs clean.
真人章纲更会搭台: A human beat sheet builds the stage better
脑洞篇的网文感均分 6.53，三期最高。题材本身有优势，真人章纲也提前搭好了节奏: The high-concept issue's mean web-fiction feel of 6.53 is the highest of the three. The genre helps — but the human beat sheet had also laid out the pacing, conflict and hooks in advance. The models only had to write them down.
去 AI 味要从章纲动手: Scrubbing the AI flavour starts at the beat sheet
章纲会定下正文的结构和表达习惯。只改正文，往往改不干净。章纲和正文都要处理。: The beat sheet fixes the prose's structure and verbal habits. Editing the prose alone rarely gets it clean — treat the beat sheet and the prose together.
三期分差里混有章纲质量的影响，不能直接按均分判断模型强弱。 <strong>做: Beat-sheet quality is mixed into the score gaps between issues, so means alone cannot rank the models. In an AI writing pipeline, manage beat-sheet quality alongside prose quality.
走完三期的四个模型: The four models that ran all three issues
这四个模型连续参加了仙侠、脑洞和年代三期测评。: These four took part in the xianxia, high-concept and period issues back to back.
第二轮名单保留了仙侠篇第一名 <strong>Gemini 3.1 Pro</s: The second-round list kept the xianxia winner Gemini 3.1 Pro, the top two Chinese models Qwen3.8 Max and Kimi K3, and the then freshly released DeepSeek V4 Flash, as a counterpart for the later-added DeepSeek V4 Pro.
四个模型三期总分走势: Total-score trajectories of four models across three issues
<strong>Gemini 3.1 Pro</strong> 是唯一三期都待在: Gemini 3.1 Pro is the only model that stayed in the top tier all three times (ranks 1 / 1 / 3), with a range of just 0.66. Kimi K3 climbed the whole way, from 5th in xianxia to 1st in period. DeepSeek V4 Flash spans 1.25 points across the three issues, the most genre-bound of the four. Qwen3.8 Max caved in once, on high-concept (4th → 9th → 6th).
GLM 和 Gemini Flash 看版本变化；GPT-5.6 看同一系列的三: GLM and Gemini Flash track version changes; GPT-5.6, three models from one family.
版本升级：GLM 与 Gemini Flash: Version upgrades: GLM and Gemini Flash
<strong>GLM-5.2 → GLM-5.3</strong> 是最成功的: GLM-5.2 → GLM-5.3 is the most successful upgrade here: +0.63 on high-concept and +1.17 on period, with cost per chapter up from $0.018 to $0.0233 — thirty percent more money for a whole tier of improvement. Gemini 3.6 → 3.7 Flash costs the same and gains +0.20 / +0.42 across the two genres.
新旧版测的是不同题材和章纲，涨幅只能参考。两组新版在脑洞和年代都涨分，方向较一致: Old and new versions were tested on different genres and beat sheets, so treat the gains as indicative. Both new versions gain on both high-concept and period, which at least points one way. The just-released Gemini 3.8 Flash will go into the next issue as soon as we can manage it.

脑洞篇和年代篇同一天入库，由同一批评委在同一时期完成。主要变量是题材及配套章纲。: The high-concept and period issues entered the pool on the same day and were scored by the same reviewers over the same stretch. The main variables are the genre and the beat sheet that came with it.
三期评分口径一致，均分最大相差 0.37 分。题材不同，评委人数也有变化，因此轨: All three issues scored to one rubric, with means at most 0.37 apart. But the genres differ and reviewer headcounts moved, so the trajectories speak to cross-genre performance — not to a model's ability changing over time.
新旧版测了不同题材和章纲，分差混有其他因素。GPT-5.6 Luna 与 Ter: Old and new versions faced different genres and beat sheets, so other factors are mixed into the gap. The same-issue contrast between GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra is the more direct one.
章纲来源不同: The beat sheets have different origins
仙侠用普通 AI 章纲，年代用人工优化过的 AI 章纲，脑洞用已发表作品的真人章: Xianxia used a plain AI beat sheet, period a hand-refined AI one, and high-concept a human beat sheet from a published work. The three issues' means cannot simply be ranked against one another.
每个模型每期只有三篇。波动大的模型均分参考价值较低，名次变化也会受随机性影响。: Three chapters per model per issue. A volatile model's mean carries little weight, and rank changes pick up randomness too.
